The takeaway
AI assistants can now talk directly to FRED through its new MCP connector to generate reliable answers, accurate charts, and complete data downloads.
FRED’s new AI connector
AI assistants can now connect directly to FRED’s trusted repository of economic data with a new tool built on the model context protocol (MCP), an open standard for linking AI tools to data sources. Full details here.
How does it work?
With the MCP connector, AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can send a request for information directly to FRED, receive the data, and turn it into a plain-spoken answer using five different tools:

Searching for data

Inspecting the metadata and methodology notes

Retrieving observations with date ranges and transformations

Generating CSV or JSON download links with the data

Rendering the immediately recognizable FRED graphs linked back to fred.stlouisfed.org

 
Continued confidence in the data
The FRED team’s commitment to data integrity and accessibility is not changing. FRED is simply being enhanced to match the way people are now searching for answers to their data questions. After installing the FRED MCP connector, you can ask your AI assistant questions about economic data and feel confident the source of that data is the same trusted source people have been using since 1991.
"How has unemployment changed since the start of the year?"
The AI assistant searches FRED, finds the headline series, pulls the actual data, and answers in plain language.
“What is year-over-year consumer price inflation?”
The AI assistant applies the data transformation for you, from an index value to a year-over-year value, and supplies the answer.
“Compare mortgage rates with the 10-year Treasury yield.”
The AI assistant renders and provides a FRED graph for you that displays both of these time series.
Suggested by Scott St. Louis and Diego Mendez-Carbajo.
